source_lottery: Austria Lotto 6 aus 45 official Lotto draw events
source_authority: Oesterreichische Lotterien / win2day official result downloads

inclusion_rule.include: Every official Lotto 6/45 archive row representing a main Lotto draw, including official Friday Lotto Bonus-Ziehung rows when present
inclusion_rule.zusatzzahl: retain for source verification if present; exclude from all main-six H18/model scoring
inclusion_rule.pre_1997_schedule: no special weighting; chronological sequential draws only

canonical_index: After official-source deduplication and chronological sort, draw_index=1..N; transferred Production round N equals draw_index
time_semantics: Residual week features are draw-lag (number of prior included draws since last appearance), not calendar weeks

partition_rule.basis: usable normalized rows after frozen structural warmup, chronological order
partition_rule.new_hypotheses_after_er1: REPLICATION_SET diagnostic-only; MODEL_HOLDOUT unavailable for new hypothesis discovery

primary_production_test.null: iid fair 6-of-45; per draw H18 ~ Hypergeometric(45,18,6); E=2.4
primary_production_test.test: one-sided exact convolution of preregistered per-draw null, or byte-verified equivalent implementation
primary_production_test.no_material_effect_rule: one-sided 95% upper confidence bound for delta is <0.05
primary_production_test.claim_limit: External transfer evidence only; NO_MATERIAL_EFFECT_GE_0_05 rules out >=0.05 under the preregistered assumptions, not all positive effects
primary_production_test.no_material_effect_ci_method: one-sided 95% Student-t upper confidence bound on the per-draw H18 mean: U=mean+t_0.95,n-1*s/sqrt(n); classify NO_MATERIAL_EFFECT_GE_0_05 only if U<2.45

secondary_component_family.multiplicity: Holm step-down over all predeclared secondary hypotheses
secondary_component_family.test_engine: Feature-set hypotheses use exact/convolved Hypergeometric(45,k_t,6) null across draws. Selector-ablation hypotheses use preregistered paired draw-level H18 randomization. F2 uses its frozen logscore null. All use preregistered direction.

hypotheses.metric: frozen F2 logscore bits per draw

secondary_component_family.power_rule: For every hypothesis report achieved MDE and power against its preregistered minimum-interest effect (MIE). If Holm support fails and power to detect that MIE in the preregistered direction is <0.80, label INCONCLUSIVE_UNDERPOWERED rather than NO_REPLICATION_SUPPORT.
secondary_component_family.korean_reference_effects: Frozen Korean diagnostics are descriptive/power-context references only; they must not define the MIE or the underpowered classification threshold.
secondary_component_family.minimum_interest_effects_status: MUST_BE_FILLED_AND_HASHED_BEFORE_PREREG_SEAL; no Austria outcomes may be inspected first

f2_secondary_test.parameters: exact frozen R17 F2 periods/beta/lambda; no refit
f2_secondary_test.multiplicity: included in secondary Holm family unless independent review requires a separately fixed family accounting

combined_model_if_secondary_support.feature_entry: Only secondary features with Holm-adjusted p<=0.05 and preregistered direction on REPLICATION_SET; no additional features
combined_model_if_secondary_support.zero_feature_rule: Do not fit a combined model; close historical-number-pattern family by default
combined_model_if_secondary_support.lambda_selection: five chronological folds within REPLICATION_SET; maximize mean held-fold log score; ties choose the larger lambda
combined_model_if_secondary_support.selector: top18 by fitted pre-draw eta; deterministic tie uses canonical draw_index and frozen Production tie-priority algorithm
combined_model_if_secondary_support.freeze_before_holdout: feature list, lambda, coefficient vector, code SHA, selector and nulls must be sealed before MODEL_HOLDOUT is opened
combined_model_if_secondary_support.model_holdout_primary: paired mean H18 vs frozen Production on MODEL_HOLDOUT
combined_model_if_secondary_support.model_holdout_gate: one-sided paired randomization/sign-flip p<=0.05 AND mean H18 delta >0; additionally report uniform H18 p-value and 4+/5+ deltas
combined_model_if_secondary_support.korean_effect: Even holdout success cannot change Korean Production directly; separate sealed Korean prospective shadow required

source_integrity.secondary_sample_rule: deterministic indices derived from SHA256('M8_ER1_SECONDARY_SAMPLE_V1|' + normalized_sha256) counter stream without replacement

termination: If no secondary component survives replication and no primary Production support is obtained, close this historical-number-pattern research family by default. A primary INCONCLUSIVE result does not authorize repeated threshold changes or reuse of REPLICATION_SET.
prohibited: alternative draw-index origin for support credit
using external-only result to change Korean Production
using consumed REPLICATION_SET for a later new-hypothesis support claim

structural_warmup_rule.definition: warmup_end_index is the first chronological included draw_index t for which the union of main-six numbers in draws 1..t contains all 45 numbers
